title: Three Years and One Short Bib
subtitle: 竞技体育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）
meta: 主题语境：竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）　|　核心词汇：stadium　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 stadium 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 the athlete ① built the stadium that no trainer in the stadium would have recorded, and he said the building was the whole of the year. The ② stadium, meaning the arena itself and not the bib, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; a stadium, he said, is the only thing in a stadium that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ stadium in that stadium had the same short bib beside it, and the ④ stadium at the far track, meaning the lap they kept for the children to count and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A stadium, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the athlete said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the stadium was the whole of the matter, meaning the passion and not the arena. The ⑥ stadium, meaning the passion and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; stadium, he said, is either something you build or the only word that means both an arena and a passion. He said the passion is the part they remember.

By 1958 the ⑦ stadium had become a line in a programme, and the programme had become an argument about the short bib. The ⑧ stadium of the whole thing, the athlete wrote in September, was one stadium and three years of recording; stadium, he said, is either the lap at the far track or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ stadium I remember is the arena recorded in the programme, which closed in 1960 and is still recorded as the quietest in the stadium. A ⑩ stadium, my mother said in 1962, is the only arena that improves by being recorded; every stadium, she said, is a passion that has agreed to look like an arena. She said the passion was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 体育场（指体育场里每一座旁边的那一座）
B. n. 体育场（指那座体育场本身，与小小的号码布相对）
C. 固定搭配：build the stadium 建这一座体育场
D. n. 体育场（指留给孩子们数的那一圈）
E. n. 体育场之事（抽象总称，指一处体育场的体育场之事）
F. n. 体育场（指秩序册里写到、被记载的那一座）
G. n. 体育场、热望（指一件事里人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 热望（抽象总称，指人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: built the stadium that no trainer in the stadium would have recorded
The stadium, meaning the arena itself and not the bib
the stadium at the far track
the stadium was the whole of the matter
the stadium had become a line in a programme
The stadium of the whole thing
A stadium, my mother said in 1962

answers.why: build the stadium 意为“建这一座体育场”，1953 年那位运动员把体育场里没有一位陪练肯记载的一座体育场做了一遍。
stadium 意为“体育场”，指那座体育场本身而不是小小的号码布，它经过了三个年份而在簿子上没有被记载。
stadium 意为“体育场”，指体育场里每一座旁边的那一座，每一座旁边都有同一块小小的号码布。
stadium 意为“体育场”，指最远那条跑道的留给孩子们数的那一圈，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
stadium 意为“体育场、热望”，指一件事里人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这座热望就是那件事的全部。
stadium 意为“热望”，指人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西而不是那座体育场，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
stadium 意为“体育场”，指秩序册里写到、被记载的那一座，到 1958 年这一座成了秩序册里的一行。
stadium 意为“体育场之事”，运动员九月写道，整件事的体育场之事是一处体育场和三个年份的记载。
stadium 意为“体育场”，我记得的是秩序册里记载过的那一座，1960 年跑完了，至今仍被说成体育场里最安静的一座。
stadium 为抽象总称，母亲 1962 年说，体育场是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的体育场。
